item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be cool over southern China in the next couple of days. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Rai will move across the southern part of the South China Sea today. It will turn to a northerly track later today and weaken gradually, but its subsequent movement and intensity remain uncertain after it enters the northern part of the South China Sea. Rain bands associated with Rai will bring rainy weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong early to midweek this week. Under the influence of a replenishment of the northeast monsoon, the weather is expected to become cool again over the coast of southern China during Christmas holidays.
